主要内容: On January 14, 2021, Broadway Financial Corporation and CFBanc Corporation amended their previously reported merger agreement dated August 25, 2020. The amendment modifies the form of amended and restated certificate of incorporation, increasing the number of shares of common stock with full voting rights from 50,000,000 to 75,000,000, subject to approval by voting common stockholders. It also expands the statement of public benefit corporation purposes, effective upon merger completion, if approved by voting stockholders. The amendments also expand severance payment eligibility for executives, effective January 14, 2021, for Brenda J. Battey, Norman Bellefeuille, and Ruth McCloud. The company plans to file a registration statement on Form S-4, including a joint proxy statement and prospectus, related to the proposed business combination with CFBanc. Investors are urged to review the documents for important information about the transaction. The filings will be available on the SEC website and the company’s website. No securities are being offered for sale unless through a prospectus meeting the requirements of the U.S. Securities Act of 1933, as amended.
